campaignevents-rest-param-desc-id: The numeric ID of the event registration.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-contribut: The numeric ID of the event contribution record to delete.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-userid: The global central user ID of the user.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-event-pag: Title of the page for this event on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-timezone: Timezone identifier for the event times, in any format accepted by PHP's DateTimeZone.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Event start time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the timezone specified by the timezone parameter.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-time: Event end time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the timezone specified by the timezone parameter.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-types: One or more event type identifiers. Maximum 2 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wikis: Wikis associated with this event. Pass ["*"] to include all wikis. Maximum 100 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-topics: Topics associated with this event. Maximum 5 values.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-online-me: Whether the event has an online meeting component.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-inperson-: Whether the event has an in-person meeting component.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-u: URL for the online meeting. Visible only to organizers and participants with the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-c: CLDR country code for the in-person meeting location.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-meeting-a: Street address for the in-person meeting location.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-chat-url: URL of the event's chat channel. Visible only to organizers and participants with the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-test-e: Whether this is a test event. Test events are excluded from statistics.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracks-co: Whether this event tracks wiki contributions made during the event period.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-type: Metric type used to measure the event goal.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-goal-targ: Target value for the event goal (minimum 1).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-tracking-: Identifier of the external tracking tool. The only currently supported value is "wikimedia-pe-dashboard", for the Programs and Events Dashboard (https://outreachdashboard.wmflabs.org/).
Event identifier within the external tracking tool. For the Programs and Events Dashboard, this is the course slug from the dashboard URL (the path after /courses/).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-status: The new status for the event.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-is-privat: Whether to register as a private participant. Private registrations are not visible to other participants.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-show-cont: Whether to show the contribution association prompt to this participant after editing.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-answers: Answers to participant questions, as an object where each key is a question name and each value is an object with a "value" key (the chosen option) and an optional "other" key (free-text input for the chosen option).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-orga: The organizer ID of the last result from the previous page, for cursor-based pagination.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-organizer: List of usernames to set as organizers. Replaces the current organizer list entirely.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-include-p: Whether to include privately registered participants. Requires organizer permissions.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-last-part: The participant ID of the last result from the previous page, for cursor-based pagination.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-username-: Filter participants whose username contains this string.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-exclude-u: List of central user IDs to exclude from results.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-remove-pa: Central user IDs to remove. Pass null to target all participants (use with invert_users).
If true, remove all participants except those in user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-use: Central user IDs to include or exclude (depending on invert_users).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-inv: If true, send email to all participants except those in user_ids.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-email-mes: Body text of the email, plaintext only.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-ccme: Whether to send a copy of the email to the sender.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-question-: Restrict results to questions with these IDs. Returns all questions if omitted.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-language-: Language code to format the times in, in the format used internally by MediaWiki (similar to BCP 47 but with some differences).
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-start-tim: Start timestamp in any format accepted by the MediaWiki timestamp parser.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-end-times: End timestamp in any format accepted by the MediaWiki timestamp parser.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-wiki: ID of the wiki where the revision was made.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-revid: Revision ID on the target wiki.
campaignevents-rest-param-desc-worklist-: Title of the worklist page. Must be a local page.
campaignevents-rest-patch-worklist-title: The worklist title must not contain an interwiki prefix or a section fragment.
campaignevents-rest-response-registratio: Event registration not found or deleted.
campaignevents-rest-response-email-accep: Email send job accepted. The sent count reflects emails dispatched.
campaignevents-rest-response-403: The user does not have permission to perform this action.
campaignevents-rest-response-404-user-no: The specified user does not exist.
campaignevents-rest-response-404-not-par: The event registration does not exist, or the current user is not registered for it.
campaignevents-rest-response-404-contrib: The specified contribution record does not exist.
campaignevents-rest-create-registration-: Creates a new event registration and adds the user as organizer. The authenticated user must have permission to enable event registrations. Returns the ID of the newly created event.
campaignevents-rest-get-registration-des: Returns full details of a single event registration identified by its numeric ID. Visibility of sensitive fields such as meeting URLs is subject to permission checks.
campaignevents-rest-update-registration-: Updates an existing event registration. The authenticated user must be an organizer of the event or have the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-delete-registration-: Permanently deletes an event registration. The authenticated user must have permission to delete the event. This action cannot be undone.
campaignevents-rest-register-for-event-d: Registers the currently authenticated user as a participant in the specified event, which must be hosted on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-cancel-own-registrat: Cancels the currently authenticated user's participation in the specified event.
campaignevents-rest-get-own-registration: Returns registration details for the currently authenticated user in the specified event, including privacy setting and any answers submitted to participant questions.
campaignevents-rest-event-list-organizer: Returns a paginated list of organizers for the specified event. This has a fixed limit of 11 organizers.
campaignevents-rest-event-set-organizers: Replaces the organizer list for the specified event with the provided list of usernames. The authenticated user must have permission to edit the event. The event must be hosted on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-event-list-participa: Returns a paginated list of participants for the specified event. Private participants are only visible to organizers and users with the appropriate permissions.
campaignevents-rest-event-remove-partici: Removes participants from the specified event based on the provided filter. The authenticated user must have permission to manage participants. The event must be on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-list-events-by-organ: Returns a list of event registrations for which the specified central user is an organizer.
campaignevents-rest-list-events-by-parti: Returns a list of event registrations for which the specified central user is a participant.
campaignevents-rest-list-own-events-for-: Returns a list of events in which the currently authenticated user is a participant and that are eligible for contribution association. Used internally to populate the post-edit contribution prompt.
campaignevents-rest-email-participants-d: Sends an email to participants of the specified event. The authenticated user must have permission to email participants. The event must be on the local wiki.
campaignevents-rest-get-participant-ques: Returns the set of questions that can be presented to participants when they register for an event.
campaignevents-rest-get-formatted-time-d: Returns localized time, date, and datetime strings for the given start and end timestamps in the specified language. Intended for internal use by the CampaignEvents front-end to render event times correctly per the viewer's language.
campaignevents-rest-associate-revision-w: Associates a specific wiki revision with the given event for contribution tracking purposes. The association is processed and finalized asynchronously.
campaignevents-rest-delete-event-contrib: Removes a specific event contribution record by its ID. The authenticated user must have permission to remove this contribution from its associated event.
campaignevents-rest-patch-worklist-pages: Applies a delta to a worklist's page list: pages to add and/or remove, grouped by wiki.
campaignevents-rest-get-worklist-pages-d: Get a list of pages in a worklist, each with the URL and CSS classes its link would have in the server-rendered worklist table (a red link for a page still to be created, an external link for another wiki). Data that belongs to a wiki rather than to a page, such as its localized name and the URL of its api.php (null when that wiki cannot be resolved), is returned once in a `wikis` map keyed by wiki ID, which each page refers to by its `wiki`.
campaignevents-rest-get-worklist-param-d: Maximum number of pages to return.
Pagination offset to get a specific page of the result set, as returned by a previous request to this endpoint.
Whether to list results backwards (for example, to get the last result page).
If provided, return only pages whose title includes this string.
campaignevents-rest-get-worklist-pages-q: Returns the quality of the requested pages, contained in a worklist, as scored by the Wikimedia Foundation's language-agnostic articlequality model. Pages that are not in the worklist are ignored, as are pages the model cannot score, so the response may name fewer pages than were asked for.
campaignevents-rest-list-discoverable-ev: Returns the open events whose worklist contains the given page and for which the authenticated user (a non-participant who has not opted out) should be shown the event discovery dialog, recording the once-per-user-and-event suppression as it does so.
